_comment: Component breakdown for kanji appearing in the deck. Hand-authored. Component names are conventional radical meanings (grain, step, woman, child...). Deliberately NOT the invented names used by other courses, which are their own creative work. Where a decomposition is contested or unhelpful, 'note' is used instead of inventing parts. A component is glossed the same way everywhere, with two deliberate exceptions where one shape really is two different components: 月 is 'moon' in 明 but 'flesh' in 然, and 王 is 'king' in 全 but 'jewel' in 理 (玉 loses its dot on the left). Both have their own entry explaining the split. Don't 'fix' them.

人.note: A pictograph, a figure walking, seen from the side.

日.note: A pictograph, the sun with a mark in the middle.

生.note: A pictograph, a shoot pushing up out of the ground.

白.note: A pictograph. Usually read as the sun just breaking the horizon.

面.note: A pictograph, a face inside its outline.

今.note: A lid drawn shut over a single stroke, this moment, closed off from the rest.

先.note: A figure striding out in front, on 儿 legs.

無.note: A thicket of strokes over 灬 fire, the lot of it burnt away to nothing.

女.note: A pictograph, a figure kneeling, arms folded across.

来.note: Originally a wheat plant. The crop that comes to you at harvest.

行.note: A crossroads seen from above. Its left half is 彳, the step radical.

前.note: Horns over 月 moon over 刂 knife. The part that goes out in front.

学.note: Sparks over a cover over 子 a child, a child under a roof, learning.

帰.note: 帚 a broom on the right. Sweep up, then go back where you came from.

一.note: A single stroke. It doesn't get simpler than this.

会.note: A roof with people gathering in underneath it.

友.note: Two hand shapes reaching the same way.

方.note: A pictograph of a plough or banner, a thing that points a way.

昨.note: 日 the sun with a marker beside it, the day just gone.

番.note: 釆 sorting laid over 田 a field, taking things in order.

考.note: 耂 an old man bent over, taking his time over it.

言.note: A mouth with the sound drawn coming out of it.

達.note: 辶 the road radical, getting there; on people it makes a group.

高.note: A pictograph, a tall building, roof and gate stacked up.

中.note: A single line driven through the centre of a box.

出.note: Stacked peaks, something pushing up and out into view.

大.note: A person stood with both arms flung wide.

当.note: A simplified form, landing squarely on the right spot.

母.note: A pictograph of a woman with the feeding marks drawn in.

父.note: A hand gripping an axe. The one who does the heavy work.

立.note: A person planted on a line of ground, feet apart.

入.note: A way in, drawn narrowing as it goes.

声.note: A voice carrying. The older form had an ear listening to it.

目.note: An eye stood on end, the lines of the lid across it.

手.note: A hand with the fingers drawn out from the wrist.

上.note: A mark sitting above the line.

元.note: Two strokes over 儿 legs, a person at their starting point.

気.note: Steam rising off something. The old form had rice giving off vapour.

丈.note: A measure of a person's full height.

夫.note: 大 a person with a pin through the hair, an adult man.

食.note: A lid sitting over a heaped dish.

山.note: Three peaks. One of the plainest pictographs there is.

族.note: A banner with arrows beneath it, a family gathered under one flag.

部.note: 阝 on the right marks a place or district, one section of it.

事.note: A hand gripping a banner, an affair being conducted, not an object.

同.note: A frame with everything tucked inside it, all under one cover.

失.note: A hand with something slipping out of it.

子.note: A swaddled infant with its arms out, in three strokes.

心.note: A pictograph of the organ itself, chambers and all.

楽.note: Strings stretched on a wooden frame, music, and the pleasure of it.

様.note: The polite 様 of address, and the way a thing looks.

申.note: Originally a bolt of lightning, a message sent upward.

礼.note: 礻 an altar on the left, and the bow you make in front of it.

自.note: A nose. Japanese speakers point at their own nose to mean "me".

回.note: A square inside a square, something going round.

変.note: A simplified form: one thing turning into another.

夜.note: A lid pulled over the day with the moon tucked underneath.

束.note: A tree with a band tied round it, everything gathered in.

止.note: A footprint planted flat. It goes no further.

俺.note: 亻 a person, the rough, masculine way of saying I.

僕.note: 亻 a person; originally "servant", which is why it lands humbler than 俺.

単.note: One of a thing, with nothing else added to it.

夢.note: 罒 an eye at 夕 evening, seeing something that isn't in the room.

寝.note: 宀 a roof with a bed underneath it, lying down for the night.

小.note: Three short strokes, the middle one shortest of all.

座.note: 广 a shelter with people down on 土 the ground beneath it.

暇.note: 日 the sun with hours borrowed off it and nothing put back.

水.note: A stream, with the current drawn running down the middle.

選.note: 辶 the road radical, walking the row and picking one out.

二.note: Two strokes. One line for each.

三.note: Three strokes stacked up. The last number you can read by counting lines.

四.note: Four walls with a pair of legs tucked inside. The shape is arbitrary. The old form was a picture of breath.

五.note: A cross pinned between a lid and a floor. Halfway to ten.

六.note: A lid balanced on two thin legs.

七.note: A 7 tipped over backwards, a stroke cut across by a hook.

八.note: Two strokes spreading apart. It also means to divide, which is where the shape came from.

九.note: A hook curling back on itself, one short of ten.

十.note: Two strokes crossing. Every direction covered, the count closed.

朝.note: 日 the sun caught among the strokes with 月 the moon still up beside it, the overlap at dawn.

少.note: 小 small with one more stroke slicing a bit off the corner.

月.note: A crescent with lines drawn across it. Squeezed onto the left of a word about the body it stands for flesh instead.

年.note: Originally 禾 grain over a person carrying it, one harvest, one year.

違.note: 辶 the road with 韋 above it, two sets of feet going opposite ways round the same enclosure.

作.note: 亻 a person beside 乍, a shape that began as notches cut into wood.

弟.note: Cord wound down a stake, turn by turn, the one further down the order.

力.note: An arm bent hard at the elbow, drawn in a single stroke.

世.note: Three tens joined at the foot, thirty years, one generation, and from there everyone in it.

死.note: 歹 bare bones with a figure folded over beside them.

早.note: 日 the sun already up over a single bare stalk.

王.note: Heaven, earth and humanity threaded on one vertical stroke. On the left of another kanji this same shape is usually 玉 jewel with its dot worn off, which is why 理 has a jewel in it and 全 has a king.

必.note: A heart with a stroke driven clean through it.

者.note: A contested shape that settled into meaning whoever does the thing named before it.

後.note: 彳 the step radical with the rest of it trailing along behind.

向.note: A window set high in a wall, pointing one way out.

音.note: 言 speech with one more stroke shut inside the mouth, so it never becomes a word.

掛.note: 扌 a hand reaching up to a peg to hang something on it.

過.note: 辶 the road radical, going past the turning, and going too far.

要.note: Originally hands on a waist. The part everything else hangs off.

受.note: One hand reaching down and another reaching up, with something passing between them.

殺.note: The 殳 on the right is a hand with a weapon raised in it.

絶.note: 糸 a thread with a blade taken to it, cut clean through, nothing after.

対.note: 寸 a hand held out toward whatever is across from it.

由.note: A field with one stroke pushing up out of the top. Where a thing comes out of.

口.note: A pictograph. A square drawn open, with nothing in it.

他.note: 亻 the person radical with 也 beside it: some person who isn't this one.

通.note: 辶 the road radical. A way that goes all the way through.

春.note: Strokes tangled over 日 the sun. Growth breaking open as it warms.

夏.note: A figure with an oversized head, drawn mid-dance. The season with the festivals in it.

以.note: A person with a mark set beside them, 'starting from here', used to fix a boundary.

最.note: A hand taking the very top thing off the pile.

左.note: A hand over 工 a carpenter's square. The hand that holds the work steady.

右.note: A hand over 口 a mouth, the hand you eat with. Same top as 左; the bottom is the difference.

胸.note: The 月 that means flesh, with the ribcage wrapped round something beneath it.

表.note: 衣 clothing with something showing through, the side that faces outward.

覚.note: The sparks and lid from the top of 学, sat down on 見 an eye.

別.note: 刂 a standing blade cutting one thing away from the rest.

開.note: 門 a gate with two hands lifting the bar out of it.

残.note: 歹 bare bones with blades beside them. What is still there once the rest has gone.

助.note: 力 power added on the right. An extra shoulder put under the load.

状.note: 犬 a dog beside a narrow upright. It means the shape a thing has taken.

確.note: 石 a stone on the left, solid enough to be sure of.

消.note: 氵 water on the left, wearing something away until it isn't there.

長.note: Long hair on an old figure, drawn flowing down.

腕.note: The 月 that means flesh, with a shape for bending beside it.

離.note: 隹 a small bird on the right, gone off the branch and leaving the rest behind.

書.note: 聿 a hand gripping a brush, sat down on the thing it marks.

光.note: A figure on 儿 legs with brightness coming off the top.

走.note: 土 the earth up top with legs driving away underneath it.

戦.note: 戈 a halberd stood up on the right, the weapon half of the character.

余.note: A roof with whatever was left over stacked underneath it.

瞬.note: 目 an eye on the left, open exactly as long as a blink.

説.note: 言 speech on the left, worked at until the sense comes loose.

決.note: 氵 water on the left. Cut a channel and it only runs one way after that.

敵.note: 攵 the strike radical stood on the right. The one you are up against.

落.note: 艹 grass and 氵 water up at the top, both on their way down.

足.note: A pictograph, 口 a knee drawn over the foot beneath it.

魔.note: 鬼 a demon crouched at the bottom, under a roof stacked with hemp.

探.note: 扌 a hand reaching down into somewhere deep and feeling about.

輩.note: 車 a cart at the bottom. A row of them, and whoever came before you in the line.

報.note: 幸 good fortune on the left with a hand on the right, news being handed over.

下.note: A mark sitting below the line, the mirror of 上.

態.note: 能 ability sat over 心 the heart. The state a thing is in.

関.note: 門 a gate with the bar shape inside it, what joins one side to the other.

奥.note: Something shut deep inside a frame, with 大 spread across the bottom.

軽.note: 車 a cart on the left, built light enough for one person to pull.

痛.note: 疒 the sickness radical wrapped the whole way round it.

点.note: 灬 fire underneath, one single spot of it, and by extension lighting one.

隠.note: 阝 a hill on the left, and something tucked round the back of it.

準.note: 氵 water on the left, levelling a thing off flat before you start.

備.note: 亻 a person on the left with everything laid out ready beside them.

着.note: 目 an eye at the bottom under a woolly top, something landing on you and staying there.

反.note: A cliff with 又 a hand underneath, turning something back the way it came.

幸.note: A shape read as good fortune, the lucky escape.

得.note: 彳 the step radical, with a hand and a prize on the right, going out and coming back holding it.

撃.note: A hand at the bottom driving down the whole weight of what sits above it.

昔.note: Strokes stacked over 日 the sun, days piled up behind you.

深.note: 氵 water on the left, with a hand reaching down into it.

髪.note: 髟 the long-hair radical spread across the top.

勝.note: 力 power down in the bottom right. Whoever came out on top.

不.note: Nothing to break off it. It cancels whatever follows.

与.note: One hand passing a thing across to another hand.

乗.note: A figure standing up in a tree, on top of the thing rather than beside it.

実.note: 宀 a roof with the crop safe underneath. What a thing turned out to actually be.

形.note: 彡 three brush strokes down the right, the marks you draw round a thing to show its outline.

扉.note: 戸 the door radical with 非 behind it. The panel that swings, not the doorway it swings in.

更.note: One shape, no clean parts. Doing the thing over, or doing more of it.

服.note: The left half is not 月, it was 舟 a boat once. The right is a hand laid on a kneeling figure, something fitted onto a person.

果.note: 木 a tree with the fruit drawn in above it. What the tree finally puts out.

用.note: One shape, no parts worth pulling off. A thing put to work.

血.note: 皿 a dish with one mark above it for what has been poured in.

負.note: 貝 a shell, money, with a figure bent over it. Carrying what you owe.

隣.note: 阝 on the left is a mound, the bank between one plot and the next. Whoever lives on the other side of it.

任.note: 亻 a person on the left with the load stacked up on the right. Handing the job over and stepping back from it.

命.note: A figure kneeling under a roof to be handed an order. The one character does the order and the life you were given.

壁.note: 土 earth at the foot of it. A wall is the ground stood up on end.

局.note: 尸 the shelter radical with the room cut short underneath. An office, or the fix you are stuck in.

構.note: 木 a tree on the left. Timber put together into a frame, so the way a thing is built up.

済.note: 氵 water on the left. Getting across it and being done, the way you are once you are on the far bank.

程.note: 禾 grain on the left, from when you measured a thing by weighing the crop. How much of it there is.

赤.note: 大 a big figure standing over 火 a fire, taking the colour off it.

送.note: 辶 the road radical with two hands lifting something onto it. It goes and you do not.

再.note: One shape, nothing to pull off it. Round again.

可.note: A bent line over 口 a mouth. The thing you are allowed to say yes to.

喜.note: A drum up on a stand with 口 a mouth underneath. Noise made on purpose.

届.note: 尸 the shelter radical with 由 a channel running under it. What comes down and lands at your door.

急.note: 心 a heart underneath with a hand grabbing above it. No time left.

愛.note: 心 a heart bundled up in the middle with 夂 trailing feet under it. Carried about wherever you go.

求.note: A fur coat with the tails left hanging off it. What everybody in the village was after.

渡.note: 氵 water on the left, with the same 度 as 一度 beside it. Getting a thing over the river and into a hand.

背.note: 北 two figures drawn back to back, over 月 the flesh sense. The side of you that faces away.

色.note: Two figures, one bent over the other, and nobody agrees why that came to mean colour. Take the meaning and leave the shape.

身.note: A figure in profile with the belly drawn out. The body you carry about.

静.note: 青 blue and fresh down the left. The colour of a room with nothing going on in it.

飛.note: Both wings up and the tail streaming out behind. A pictograph.

似.note: 亻 a person on the left with 以 beside them, the marker that fixes one thing against another. Held up for comparison.

倒.note: 亻 a person with 到 reaching its destination beside them, except this one arrives on the floor.

像.note: 亻 a person next to 象 an elephant, which also does the shape of a thing. A likeness rather than the thing itself.

危.note: A figure crouched at the top of a cliff with another underneath it. Nothing good is about to happen.

周.note: A border drawn the whole way round with 口 a mouth beneath it. The same 周 that sits inside 調べる.

想.note: 相 taking the measure of something, sat on 心 a heart. What forms in there when the thing itself is not in front of you.

慌.note: 忄 a heart on the left with everything running wild alongside it.

熱.note: 灬 fire down at the bottom, the same four dots as 然. Whatever is sitting above them is getting it.

眠.note: 目 an eye on the left with the lids down. That is the whole story.

腰.note: 月 the flesh sense with 要 beside it, the shape that began as hands on a waist. The part that gives out first.

険.note: 阝 a mound on the left, and the steep sort. Ground you can come off.

頷.note: 頁 a head on the right, doing the one thing that answers without a word.

々.note: Not a kanji. Typesetters call it ノマ because that is what it looks like, katakana ノ sat on マ. It means repeat the character before it, so 色々 is 色色 and 人々 is 人人. Formally it is a 踊り字, a dancing mark.

切.note: 刀 a blade on the right. Everything to the left of it is what the blade goes through.

唇.note: 口 a mouth down at the bottom. The lips are the part of it you can see.

料.note: 米 rice on the left with a measure beside it. Portioning out ingredients, and then what you are charged for them.

期.note: 月 the moon on the right, counting off months. A set stretch of time with an end to it.

森.note: Three 木 trees. 林 with two is a wood; three is a forest you could get lost in.

正.note: 止 a footprint with 一 a line drawn in front of it. Pulling up exactly on the mark rather than past it.

甘.note: A mouth with something held inside it. Whatever it is, nobody is spitting it out.

直.note: 目 an eye with a line running straight down out of it. Looking at a thing dead on.

耳.note: A pictograph of an ear, drawn side on.

能.note: No clean parts to pull off. Take it as what a thing is able to do.

襲.note: 龍 a dragon sat on top of 衣 clothing. It comes down on you from above and you had no say in it.

遅.note: 辶 the road radical with something unhurried on it. Behind, and getting further behind.

遊.note: 辶 the road radical again, this time with nowhere in particular to be.

邪.note: 牙 a fang on the left with 阝 a mound behind it. Something in your way, and not kindly meant.

降.note: 阝 a mound on the left with feet coming down the side of it.

震.note: 雨 rain across the top and everything underneath it shaking.

頃.note: 頁 a head on the right, tilted over the way it goes when somebody is guessing.

首.note: Hair drawn on top with the neck below it. The part the head sits on.

冷.note: 冫 two marks of ice on the left. Whatever they are stood next to has gone cold.

叫.note: 口 a mouth on the left with something twisted beside it. The noise that comes out before you decide to make it.

婚.note: 女 a woman on the left. The right half is dusk, which is when the ceremony used to happen.

引.note: 弓 a bow, with the line beside it standing for the string coming back.

慣.note: 忄 a heart with the same thing threaded through it again and again until it stops registering.

捨.note: 扌 a hand on the left, opening. The rest of the character is what it was holding.

握.note: 扌 a hand on the left closing round something and not opening again.

既.note: A figure turning away from a bowl that has been finished with. Done, before you got here.

激.note: 氵 water on the left, thrown hard at something rather than merely running past it.

狙.note: 犭 the beast radical flattened into the grass on the left, with everything about it pointed one way.

珍.note: 王 in its jewel sense on the left, the same shape as in 理. Something you do not see twice.

納.note: 糸 thread on the left, taking something in and stowing it where it belongs.

諦.note: 言 speech on the left, because this one has to be said out loud before it counts.

謝.note: 言 speech on the left with an arrow being loosed beside it. Words sent out on purpose.

逆.note: 辶 the road radical with a figure drawn upside down on it, going against the flow.

途.note: 辶 the road radical with 余 whatever is left over. The part of the journey still ahead.

酷.note: 酉 a wine jar on the left and the strength of what comes out of it. Too much of anything.

重.note: A bundle with the weight of it drawn running straight through the middle.

風.note: A frame with 虫 an insect inside it, from the old idea that the wind carried them.

黒.note: Soot caught in a window with 灬 fire underneath it. What the fire leaves behind.

両.note: Two of a thing held inside one frame.

予.note: One shape, nothing to pull off it. Settled in advance.

冗.note: 宀 a roof over 儿 legs. Somebody underneath it with nothing much to do.

判.note: 刂 a standing blade on the right, cutting two things apart so you can tell which is which.

勢.note: 力 power down at the bottom, and everything above it building up on top.

嘘.note: 口 a mouth on the left with emptiness beside it. Sound coming out with nothing behind it.

地.note: 土 earth on the left. The ground itself, and by extension a place on it.

増.note: 土 earth on the left, piled higher, and then piled higher again.

奪.note: 大 a big figure over a bird held in a hand. It was somebody else's a second ago.

定.note: 宀 a roof with something settled underneath it and not moving again.

慢.note: 忄 a heart on the left slowed right down. Patience, or conceit, depending which way it goes.

我.note: A hand holding a halberd. The self drawn as the thing that defends itself.

断.note: 斤 an axe on the right, taking a thing off for good.

望.note: 月 the moon down at the bottom right, and somebody a long way off looking up at it.

未.note: A tree with the top branch not grown out. Not yet, rather than never.

流.note: 氵 water on the left, going where water goes.

窓.note: 穴 a hole in the wall with 心 a heart under it. The opening you stare out of.

素.note: 糸 thread at the bottom, undyed. The material before anything has been done to it.

絡.note: 糸 thread on the left, tying one thing on to the next.

綺.note: 糸 thread on the left with 奇 strange beside it. Woven better than it needed to be.

緊.note: 糸 thread at the bottom, pulled until it will not give any further.

繰.note: 糸 thread on the left, wound round and round and round again.

肉.note: A pictograph of a cut of meat with the grain drawn through it.

花.note: 艹 grass over a figure changing into something else, which is what a plant does when it flowers.

談.note: 言 speech on the left with a double fire beside it. Talk that goes on long enough to warm up.

追.note: 辶 the road radical with somebody already gone up it and you coming along behind.

避.note: 辶 a road that bends round a thing rather than going straight at it.

響.note: 音 sound at the bottom, thrown back off everything stacked above it.

麗.note: A deer with its antlers drawn out evenly on both sides. Fine, and matched.

並.meaning: line up, stand in a row
並.note: Two people standing 立 side by side in the older form. The modern shape has levelled them into one flat row.

器.note: Four mouths 口 set around a dog in the middle, written 大 in the modern form. Vessels laid out on every side.

寂.note: A roof 宀 with almost nothing left underneath it. The right half only lends the sound.

弱.note: Two bows 弓 side by side, each with its string hanging slack in a pair of soft marks.

段.note: Steps cut into a cliff on the left, and a hand holding a tool on the right doing the cutting.

興.note: Hands at all four corners lifting something up together, the shape of a thing being raised.

貴.note: Money 貝 carried up in both hands. What gets held that way is the precious thing.

質.note: Two axes 斤 above money 貝, the weighing that says what a thing is really worth.

金.note: Two nuggets buried in the earth under a cover. The metal you dig for, and the money it becomes.

傷.note: A person 亻 on the left and the mark of something driven into them on the right. What is left after the blow.

協.note: Ten 十 on the left and three lots of 力 power stacked on the right, everybody pulling the same way at once.

叩.note: 口 a mouth beside 卩 a kneeling figure. Knocking at a door and calling out through it at the same time.

巨.note: A carpenter's rule with a handle, drawn end on. The measure you reach for when the small one will not go round it.

影.note: 日 the sun over a tall building, and 彡 three streaks falling away from it. What the light leaves behind.

接.note: 扌 a hand on the left reaching out until it touches. The point where two things meet and stay met.

数.note: 攵 a hand with a stick on the right, going along a row and ticking things off one at a time.

木.note: A pictograph, a trunk with branches spread above it and roots spread below.

浮.note: 氵 water on the left, and a hand reaching down over a child on the right. Held up so it does not go under.

主.note: A lamp on its stand with the flame drawn in above. The one thing in a room that everything else is arranged around.

匂.note: Made in Japan rather than borrowed from Chinese, which is why it has no on reading. A wrapper with something caught inside it.

化.note: A person 亻 on the left and the same figure turned over on the right. One thing going and another arriving in its place.

半.note: A line drawn straight down the middle of something, and the two sides opened out either side of it.

厳.note: A cliff face with something being taken firm hold of underneath it. Nothing here is making allowances for you.

参.note: Three streaks under a head, a figure falling in with something already under way rather than starting it.

売.note: A stall with a lid over the top and 儿 legs underneath. Goods set out, and somebody standing behind them all day.

席.note: A shelter 广 with a mat spread out under it. The mat is the seat, and either somebody is on it or it is going spare.

成.note: Built on 戈 a halberd, with a stroke carried through it. Seeing a thing all the way to the end of itself.

抜.note: 扌 a hand on the left pulling, and whatever it had hold of coming away with it.

挨.note: Half of 挨拶 and hardly seen outside it. 扌 a hand, pushing up close to somebody.

拶.note: The other half of 挨拶, and it appears nowhere else at all. 扌 a hand again, the two of them pressed together.

暮.note: 日 the sun sitting at the bottom with the day's growth heaped over the top of it. The light going, and the days going with it.

満.note: 氵 water on the left, filled right up to the top of whatever is holding it and no room left.

石.note: A cliff on the left with a lump drawn underneath, fallen off and lying where it landed.

示.note: An altar with the offerings set out on top, put up where everybody can see them.

経.note: 糸 thread on the left, run the whole length of the thing. What you have been through from one end to the other.

練.note: 糸 thread on the left again, worked over and over by hand until it finally runs smooth.

耐.note: 寸 a hand on the right, holding on. Whatever is pushing against it, it has not let go yet.

験.note: 馬 a horse on the left, and the going over you give one before you agree to buy it.

代.note: 亻 a person on the left with a marker set beside them, one standing in the place of another.

包.note: A figure bent right over, drawn folded around whatever it is carrying.

原.note: A cliff with a spring running out from underneath it. Open ground, and the place the water starts.

平.note: A surface with the weight spread evenly to either side of the stem. Nothing sticking up anywhere.

廊.note: 广 a shelter on the left, and the long thin strip of space that runs along under it.

恐.note: 心 a heart at the bottom with a pair of hands gripping something above it. The grip is the fear.

打.note: 扌 a hand on the left and a nail on the right, the hand bringing something down onto it.

押.note: 扌 a hand on the left, pressing down on something and keeping it pressed.

掴.note: 扌 a hand on the left closing round something and not opening again. Usually written in kana.

景.note: 日 the sun up over a tall building. Not the buildings, the thing you see when you look out at them.

格.note: 木 a tree on the left, worked to a standard. The frame a thing is built to, and how it comes across.

機.note: 木 a tree on the left, cut into a frame with moving parts. It carries the machine and the moment things line up.

火.note: A pictograph, a flame with sparks going off to either side of it.

炎.note: One 火 fire stacked straight on top of another. Not the fire, the blaze coming off it.

皆.note: Two figures side by side over 白 white at the bottom. Everybody, counted together rather than one at a time.

紙.note: 糸 thread on the left, pulped and pressed out flat. What paper was before it was paper.

闘.note: 門 a gate with two of them going at each other inside it. The older form put weapons in their hands.

互.note: Two hooks turned to face each other and locked together. Neither of them does anything on its own.

密.note: 宀 a roof with everything packed in tight underneath it and a hill behind. Nothing gets out that way.

尋.note: A hand at the top and another at the bottom with a mouth in between, feeling about for something and asking after it.

復.note: 彳 a step on the left, going back over ground already covered once.

悩.note: 忄 a heart on the left and a head full of knots beside it, going round and round the same thing.

慮.note: A tiger's stripes over a heart doing the thinking. Weighing a thing carefully, because it might yet bite.

敷.note: 攵 a hand with a stick on the right, working something out flat across the ground.

椅.note: 木 a tree on the left, cut up and put back together in an odd shape standing on four legs.

犬.note: A pictograph. 大 a big figure with one extra stroke, which is the ear standing up.

秘.note: 禾 grain on the left, held back and not shown to anybody who asks.

茶.note: 艹 grass on top of a shelter. The leaf that gets picked and dried, and everything poured out of it after.

薄.note: 艹 grass on top with water underneath, spread out so thin you can see straight through it.

裏.note: 里 a village tucked away inside 衣 a garment. The side of the cloth that nobody is meant to see.

迎.note: 辶 the road radical, going out along it to meet somebody coming the other way.

遠.note: 辶 the road radical with a long stretch of it drawn out below. Far enough that you think twice.

限.note: 阝 a hill on the left. The point at which the ground stops going your way and you stop with it.

随.note: 阝 a hill on the left again, with a road running along beside it. Going where it goes rather than choosing.

雨.note: A pictograph, drops falling out of a line of cloud.

馬.note: A pictograph. The mane runs along the top and the four strokes underneath are the legs.

鹿.note: A pictograph, antlers up top and the legs beneath. The same animal stands inside 麗 lovely.

魂.note: 鬼 a ghost on the right with 云 a cloud beside it. Whatever is left of a person once the body has finished.

介.note: A figure with something held out to either side, stood in the middle of the two of them.

写.note: A cover over a thing being set down again exactly as it was. Copying first, and photographs once those arrived.

剣.note: 刂 the knife radical on the right, drawn out to twice the length. A blade meant to be held in both hands.

勘.note: 力 power on the right with a heavy weight on the left. Working a thing out by feel instead of by looking.

希.note: Cloth woven loosely enough that the gaps show through. Thin, so scarce, and from there the thing you are hoping for.

戒.note: 戈 a halberd held up in both hands and kept ready rather than used. Standing guard over something.

拠.note: 扌 a hand on the left, taking hold of whatever you are standing your argument on.

揺.note: 扌 a hand on the left with a jar stacked above and below on the right, and the whole lot rocking.

業.note: A rack of tools drawn hanging in a row. The work itself, and then the trade you do it in.

疑.note: A figure stopped at a fork with a stick still in hand, not committing to either road yet.

真.note: A lid over something set down straight and true underneath it. Nothing altered on the way.

腹.note: 月 the flesh radical on the left. The part of you that gives out first when you laugh too hard.

舌.note: A tongue drawn coming up out of 口 a mouth.

衝.note: 重 heavy set inside a crossroads. Two things arriving at the same point at the same moment.

褒.note: 衣 a garment wrapped the whole way round somebody, which is what praise feels like when it lands.

適.note: 辶 the road radical, and the one turning off it that happens to be right for where you are going.

鋭.note: 金 metal on the left, worked down to an edge fine enough to cut you before you have noticed.

鍵.note: 金 metal on the left, cut to a shape that fits exactly one lock and no other.

際.note: 阝 a hill on the left and the edge where it runs up against everything else. The moment two things touch.

電.note: 雨 rain along the top with the lightning coming down out of it. The storm first, then everything we run off it.

壊.note: 土 earth on the left, and whatever had been standing on it going back to being nothing but earth.

士.note: A figure stood upright with something laid across the shoulders. The one who serves, and later the samurai.

展.note: 尸 the shelter shape over something being laid out flat and opened up for people to come and look at.

差.note: A hand reaching out from under a slanted top. The gap between two things, and the holding of one of them out.

巻.note: Something rolled up from the bottom, drawn coiling round on itself. A scroll, and the volume it holds.

建.note: A brush held upright over a long stride. Setting a thing up so that it stands there afterwards.

扱.note: 扌 a hand on the left, taking hold of a thing and doing something with it. How you treat what you are holding.

机.note: 木 a tree on the left, cut down to a flat top and a couple of legs, and nothing else asked of it.

獣.note: 犬 a dog stood on the right with a hunting weapon beside it. The wild sort, not the one asleep by the fire.

発.note: Two feet at the top and a bow being loosed underneath. Something setting off, and whatever gets let go.

第.note: 竹 bamboo on top, whose joints come one after another in order. It marks which number in a sequence.

臓.note: 月 the flesh radical on the left, and what is kept stored away out of sight inside it.

良.note: Grain being sorted, with the good part kept back and everything else let fall.

車.note: A pictograph seen from above, the axle running straight through with a wheel to either side of it.

軍.note: A cart 車 with a cover pulled over the top. Chariots drawn up together, and the men who come with them.

辺.note: 辶 the road radical, and the ground lying either side of it. Round about, rather than anywhere exact.

量.note: A weight drawn sitting on a measure. How much of the thing there turns out to be once somebody has counted.

乱.note: A hand pulling at a tangle of threads on the left with a hook on the right. Everything at cross purposes at once.

偶.note: 亻 a person on the left with a creature beside them they had no expectation of meeting. Happening to run into a thing.

園.note: 囗 a border drawn the whole way round a piece of ground, with everything that grows in it kept inside.

型.note: 土 earth along the bottom, pressed into a mould. Everything that comes out of it afterwards is the same shape.

天.note: 大 a person with both arms flung wide and a single line drawn above them. Whatever is over your head.

客.note: 宀 a roof with somebody underneath it who does not live there. They came, and at some point they go.

常.note: A long cloth hanging down below, the same one day after day. The thing that is always there.

怪.note: 忄 a heart on the left that has caught hold of something it cannot account for.

惑.note: 心 a heart at the bottom under a halberd guarding a border. Torn about which way it ought to go.

抑.note: 扌 a hand on the left with a kneeling figure beside it. Keeping a thing down rather than shoving it along.

抗.note: 扌 a hand on the left, put up against whatever is coming and not stepping out of its way.

条.note: A branch drawn under a cover. One strand of a thing, and from there one clause of an agreement.

柔.note: 木 a tree at the bottom with a spear shaft above it, the wood still young enough to bend instead of snapping.

派.note: 氵 water on the left splitting off into branches. One stream going its own way apart from the rest.

混.note: 氵 water on the left with everything stirred through it until no one part can be picked back out.

為.meaning: do, act, for the sake of
為.note: Originally a hand leading an elephant. Doing something, and doing it for the sake of something else.

璧.note: 玉 a jewel at the bottom, the flat ring sort, and this one without a single mark anywhere on it.

試.note: 言 speech on the left with a set form beside it. Putting a thing through its paces to find out.

責.note: 貝 money down at the bottom with a mark over the top of it. What is owed, and who has to answer for it.

久.note: A figure with something dragging along behind it, holding it back. Time going on for longer than it ought to.

了.note: One stroke with a hook on the end of it, the shape of a thing closed off. Done, with nothing left hanging.

争.note: Two hands pulling at the same object from opposite ends, and neither of them letting go of it.

労.note: 力 power down at the bottom under a cover, put in out of sight. The effort, and what it takes out of you.

寒.note: 宀 a roof with straw packed underneath and 冫 two marks of ice along the bottom. Not enough of either of them.

式.note: 工 a carpenter's square with a mark above it. A set form to be followed, and the ceremony run off it.

恋.note: 心 a heart at the bottom with everything tangled up above it. The romantic sort, not the steady sort.

殴.note: A weapon in a hand on the right and somebody boxed in on the left. Nothing about it is a tap.

画.note: A brush drawn across a field with a border ruled round the outside. The picture, and the strokes it is built from.

穴.note: A cave mouth with a roof over it, drawn as an opening you could climb into.

辛.note: A tattooing needle, the mark of a punishment. Sharp on the tongue, and hard to put up with.

青.note: Fresh growth drawn over a well. The colour of new plants, and of the sea on a good day.

万.note: One shape with nothing worth pulling off it. The number that started out meaning simply a great many.

価.note: 亻 a person on the left, weighing up what the thing in front of them is actually worth.

吸.note: 口 a mouth on the left drawing something inward rather than letting it back out.

央.note: A figure stood with a frame drawn to either side of it, dead in the middle of the two.

川.note: Three lines running down the page, which is water between two banks seen from above.

役.note: 彳 a step on the left. The part you are handed and then walk out to go and do.

替.note: Two of the same thing side by side over 日 the sun, one of them stepping into the other's place.

毒.note: Growth drawn over 母 mother. The plant in the hedge that you do not put in your mouth.

汗.note: 氵 water on the left, the sort that comes out of you rather than out of a tap.

異.note: A figure holding something up in both hands, and whatever it is does not match anybody else's.

研.note: 石 stone on the left, ground down flat and even. Working away at a thing until it finally comes clear.

穏.note: 禾 grain on the left with everything settled in behind it. Nothing about the year is going wrong.

究.note: 穴 a hole up at the top and somebody going all the way down to the bottom of it.

純.note: 糸 thread on the left with nothing else spun into it. One material and no mixture anywhere.

膝.note: 月 the flesh radical on the left. The joint that takes the fall before any other part of you does.

術.note: 行 a crossroads with something threaded through the middle. A way of doing a thing, learned rather than guessed at.

覆.note: A lid drawn across the top with something going back and forth underneath it. Covered right over.

非.note: Two wings drawn back to back, each facing away from the other. Against, and not.

制.note: 刂 a blade on the right, cutting a thing down to a set shape. The rules, and whatever they hold in line.

刺.note: 刂 a blade on the right with a thorn on the left. Something going in, and the jolt that comes with it.

喉.note: 口 a mouth on the left and the passage sitting behind it, which is the part that goes first in winter.

妻.note: A hand drawn over a figure with a hairpin in. The one who ran the house, in the old sense of it.

寄.note: 宀 a roof you duck in under on the way to somewhere else. Stopping in rather than arriving.

察.note: 宀 a roof over a ceremony being watched closely to see how it goes. Looking hard enough at a thing to work it out.

文.note: A pattern drawn across a chest, which is the oldest writing there is. The mark first, and then the sentence.

有.note: A hand drawn over 月 the flesh. Holding onto something, and from there having it at all.

濡.note: 氵 water on the left with rain up above it. Soaked the whole way through rather than splashed.

焼.note: 火 fire on the left, put underneath a thing on purpose. Grilling, baking and burning it are all the one verb.

爆.note: 火 fire on the left with something violent alongside. Fire that does not stay where it was put.

脱.note: 月 the flesh radical on the left with something coming away from it. A coat, or an escape.

船.note: 舟 a boat on the left, drawn as a hull seen side on. The bigger sort, with people aboard.

門.note: A pair of doors drawn side by side, which is the shape you walk through.

鬼.note: A figure with an outsized head on it, the shape used for whatever is left of the dead.

具.note: A vessel held up in both hands with whatever goes in it. The gear you need, and what a dish is actually made of.

古.note: 十 ten mouths that have passed the thing down between them. Old enough to have been told ten times over.

含.note: 口 a mouth at the bottom with something being held inside it rather than swallowed down.

微.note: 彳 a step on the left, taken so small that nobody would notice it being taken at all.

捕.note: 扌 a hand on the left closing round something that was in the middle of getting away.

掃.note: 扌 a hand on the left with 帚 a broom in it, the same broom that stands on the right of 帰.

援.note: 扌 a hand on the left, put out toward somebody who is in need of one.

旅.note: 方 a banner on the left with people drawn following behind it. A party on the move rather than one person.

沈.note: 氵 water on the left with something going down into it and not coming back up again.

溢.note: 氵 water on the left and a dish already full to the brim. Over the edge of it and onto the floor.

漏.note: 氵 water on the left, coming through a roof that was put there to keep it out.

潰.note: 氵 water on the left with whatever is under it going flat. Crushed rather than broken in two.

硬.note: 石 stone on the left. Hard the way a stone is, and it gives nothing at all when you press it.

秀.note: 禾 grain with the head of it drawn bending over, the one ear that came up better than the rest of the field.

組.note: 糸 thread on the left, plaited in with another one. Two separate things made into a single team.

育.note: A child drawn upside down over 月 the flesh, which is the way one arrives. Everything after that is the raising.

舐.note: 舌 a tongue on the left, out and doing the work itself.

誤.note: 言 speech on the left that came out other than the way it was meant to.

雪.note: 雨 rain along the top with a hand underneath it, sweeping. The sort of weather you clear rather than shelter from.

井.note: The frame of a well seen from above, four beams crossed over at the corners.

兵.note: An axe held up in both hands. The one carrying it rather than the weapon being carried.

句.note: 口 a mouth with something wrapped round it. A set run of words rather than a whole sentence.

従.note: 彳 a step on the left, with somebody walking along behind whoever is out in front.

懐.note: 忄 a heart on the left holding onto something that it has no intention of putting down.

才.note: A shoot pushing up through the ground. What was there from the start rather than put in later.

投.note: 扌 a hand on the left letting go of something halfway through the swing.

査.note: 木 a tree over a stack of something, gone through one layer at a time until the bottom.

比.note: Two figures drawn side by side facing the same way, set up against one another.

氷.note: 水 water with one extra stroke on it, which is all it takes. The same stuff, gone solid.

病.note: 疒 the sickness radical wrapped round the outside of it, the same one that stands in 痛.

至.note: An arrow drawn coming down onto a line. The far end of the flight rather than the loosing of it.

複.note: 衤 the clothing radical on the left, layer over layer of it. More than one of the same thing.

雑.note: 隹 a small bird on the right with everything else heaped in on the left. Mixed together, and not sorted.

騒.note: 馬 a horse on the left with something biting at it. Nothing about the result is quiet.

魚.note: A pictograph stood on its tail, the head up top and the fins drawn as the four marks below.

鳥.note: A pictograph, the eye and beak at the top and the tail feathers as the marks underneath.

保.note: 亻 a person on the left with a child held in against them. Keeping a thing safe rather than merely having it.

偉.note: 亻 a person on the left who stands clear of the row. Great in the sense of somebody worth looking up at.

印.note: A hand pressing down on a kneeling figure. The stamp itself, and then the mark it leaves behind.

史.note: A hand holding a writing tablet, which is the record keeper. Whatever got written down and then kept.

太.note: 大 big with one extra mark put on it. Bigger than big, and thick along with it.

島.note: A bird 鳥 sitting over a mountain 山, which from a boat is exactly what an island looks like.

幼.note: 力 power on the right and a very small thread on the left. Not a great deal of either one yet.

戸.note: One leaf of a door, which is to say half of 門 the gate.

担.note: 扌 a hand on the left taking the weight of a thing and then keeping hold of it.

歴.note: 止 a footprint at the bottom under a row of trees. One step after another, and then the record of them.

漂.note: 氵 water on the left with something riding on top of it, going wherever the water happens to go.

片.meaning: one side, one of a pair
片.note: Half of a tree split straight down the middle, the right hand half. One of a pair, and the other is elsewhere.

象.note: A pictograph of an elephant, trunk included. It also does the shape or figure that a thing presents.

踏.note: 足 the foot radical on the left, put down flat on top of something.

鼻.note: The 自 nose shape sat on a stand. 自 was the original nose and got taken over to mean self, so this was built to replace it.
